notes.title: Stunning new free-to-play pirate RPG could cure your post Expedition 33 blues
notes.notes:
Clair Obscur Expedition 33 is one of those special games that's so good it leaves a hole in your heart once it's over. Its stunning worlds, sweeping soundtrack, and stylish combat are tough to match - but a potential answer to that longing is now sailing over the horizon. Sea of Remnants is an upcoming, free-to-play pirate RPG that has just staked its claim in emphatic style with an impressive trailer.
